title: All clock records are day-grouped and windowed in one report-level time zone, with partial and cross-midnight records split correctly
custom_preconds:
1. A technician has a clock record that starts before the selected range and ends inside it.
2. A technician has a clock record that crosses midnight.
3. For the multi-zone check: locations in two different time zones are selected, with clock records at each.
custom_steps:
1. Open the report and expand the technician with the cross-midnight record; read the two day rows.
2. Check the technician whose record straddles the range boundary.
3. With two differently-zoned locations selected, check which day each record lands on.
custom_expected:
1. A record that crosses midnight is split by day - each day counts only its own hours; the midnight split is evaluated in the active workplace's time zone.
2. A record that starts before the range (or ends after it) counts only the part inside the range.
3. EVERY record is day-grouped and windowed in a SINGLE report-level time zone - the active workplace's - regardless of the location where it was clocked (a record's day, the current-month boundary, and the midnight split all use that one zone).
4. This matches the Timesheet Activities report's single-time-zone grouping.
